finding.expected: Before reusing an existing managed profile, deterministically validate its effort against the repository-owned capability policy while preserving its exact bound model/effort values; a change to repository defaults alone must not alter an already-bound profile. Add a regression with a same-RUN/same-Executor persisted sidecar containing an unsupported effort and prove the native runner count stays zero. Do not add model allowlists, fallback, routing, or TASK-163 selection surfaces.
finding.issue: A pre-existing profile sidecar for the same RUN and Executor is parsed and reused after checking only run_id/executor. parse_execution_profile checks reasoning_effort only as a non-empty string, so a persisted sidecar containing an effort that is not supported by the repository-owned policy can bypass the resolver and reach native command construction. The current invalid-effort tests cover only fresh resolution, not the persisted/restart path. This violates AC3 and the hard requirement that invalid effort fail before native invocation.
